llmConfigName.description: The name of {@link Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.REA.ModelInferenceConfig} for Image Verbalization.

modelName.description:
The name of the vision language model to use for verbalization.
* `bedrock` is for Claude models via AWS Bedrock
* `vertex` is for calls through Vertex (either to Google or to Anthropic models).
  * `gemini` is equivalent to `vertex` and may be used for calls through Vertex. It is kept for backward compatibility.
* `openai` is for calls through OpenAI.
  * `gpt4v` is equivalent to `openai` and may be used for calls through OpenAI. It is kept for backward compatibility.

maxLength.description: The max length allowed for the generated chunk after verbalization.

modelParams.description: Model params for the vision language model.

verbalizationPromptTemplate.description: Prompt for the vision language model.
